findings.source: reflection_audit.py keys() lines 36-49 and relevant_string() lines 30-34: for importlib.import_module only args[0]/name is inspected; the package argument (args[1] / package=) and builtins.__import__ level (args[4] / level=) are ignored, and a relative name is never composed with its package before the protected-module test

findings.validity: business_auth.py overlay only (same file/shape as the four 9266 cases), valid AST, no new unbound names, 15/15 closure witnesses, six frozen roots preserved, full t1_provenance.provenance at final producers; nothing imported or executed
findings.minimalCorrection: In keys(): for importlib.import_module also return the package argument (args[1] or keyword package) when present; for builtins.__import__ also return level (args[4] or keyword level). Treat a non-literal package/level as unknown. Treat a relative name (leading '.') or a nonzero level as relevant-unknown unless the composed absolute name is provably unprotected (or simply: relative/levelled enumerated import = unknown, exact frozen match or refuse). Regression: these three refuse; existing controls and the 72028 positive still ACCEPT.

findings.source: callee_identity.py rebound() lines 30-45: a global declaration is honoured only for an ast.Name Store/Del; an import, def or class that binds the declared global inside a function, and 'from X import *' in the callee's scope (alias '*' is compared to the name), are not seen as rebinding
counterexamples: L2-near-lan_pilot-global-import-in-function: replacing the two blank lines before the __main__ guard with 'def _claude_install(): global _current_finalized_batch; from foreign_module import _current_finalized_batch' and '_claude_install()' -> ACCEPT; lan_pilot :1872/:1990 then pass conn to the foreign callee (same causal escape as the 9266 wrapper)
L2-near-lan_pilot-star-import-shadow: replacing them with 'from foreign_module import *' (foreign __all__ may list _current_finalized_batch) -> ACCEPT
binder-only: global + nested def, global + import, star import -> owned formal still bound, no CALLEE_REBOUND
findings.validity: tools/lan_pilot.py line-count-preserving replacement as in the actual 9266 case, valid AST, no new unbound names, 15/15 witnesses, six frozen roots preserved, full provenance at final producers; nothing imported or executed
findings.minimalCorrection: In rebound(): (a) when name is declared global in a function, any binding of it there (Import/ImportFrom alias, FunctionDef/ClassDef name, MatchAs/MatchStar/MatchMapping rest, ExceptHandler name, Name Store/Del) is a module rebinding; (b) an ImportFrom with '*' in the callee's binding scope is a rebinding unless frozen-identical; optionally (c) the same for nonlocal-declared names of a nested callee. Regression: these two refuse; existing controls and the 72028 positive still ACCEPT.
